label: Fission conditional boundary and unbuilt resurrection interpretation
summary: Analyst conditional continuation/identity incompatibility, symmetric deterministic selection obstruction, and context-indexed verdict-invariance conflict with finite omission and nonbranching/overlapping-trajectory controls. Existing Theseus and material-constitution results do not supply a personal identity criterion. Selected Parfit/Lewis readings are preserved with precise locators and limits in docs/notes/personal-identity-fission-1397.md; doctrinal reading provisionally favors bodily same-subject resurrection but supplies no formal soul/body/person criterion. Rejected body-person conflation, psychology-only complete-symmetry inference, cross-world individual equalities and resurrection refutation. All applications and the Creed bridge remain OPEN; finite models are structural surrogates. Next test: selected re-embodiment/individuation criterion and explicit rival comparison, with coordinator decision before Root semantics changes. Continuation: read selected Catechism365–366/997–1001, STq75a4/q76a1–2/a8 and Supplementq79a1–3. The latter supplies a same-soul/same-body/retained-substantial-being reconstruction, not bare soul-token sufficiency. Preserve strongest hylomorphic reply and organismic/psychological/overlapping commitments in the same note. Thin-profile certificate shows continuous token availability plus per-time attachment uniqueness does not imply all-time mate stability; it is no full Thomistic countermodel or personal identity criterion. Rejected person=pair, soul=person, token=esse and inventory=body shortcuts. Next discriminating scope: relevant original matter under turnover/restoration versus organismic life-process identity. Further selected Supplementq80a4–5 reading preserves its preferred no-permanent-signate-part turnover account and priority/divine-supplementation response to shared material. This answers the fixed-lifetime-inventory objection within that framework but does not establish whether zero original-material overlap suffices. The next test is its exact minimum-overlap/relevant-matter criterion against organismic continuation, without weakening the source.
